law_record.title: Restricted turns
law_record.text: Whenever authorized signs are erected indicating that no right turn, left turn or U-turn is permitted, it shall be unlawful for any person operating a bicycle, electric bicycle, or electric scooter to disobey the direction of any such sign, except where such person dismounts from the bicycle, electric bicycle, or electric scooter to make any such turn, in which event such person shall then obey the regulations applicable to pedestrians.

activation_conditions: authorized signs indicate that a right turn, left turn or U-turn is not permitted
the subject rides a bicycle, electric bicycle or electric scooter and makes that turn
exceptions: where the rider dismounts to make the turn, in which case the pedestrian rules apply instead
residue: a dismount is read from posture and speed; a source that cannot tell a walked machine from a ridden one reports unknown
summary.subject: rider

timing_requirements.requirement: the turn is the act judged
the dismount must precede the turn for the exception to hold
